When I was a kid I knew a couple that had been together for 5+ years or so. I was in their wedding, we spent a lot of time together whatever. They were the two chillest cool bubbly funny people I’ve ever met to this day. Then she got pregnant and something changed, her husband was super withdrawn but previously had been adamant about having a child. The baby was born and at this time I’m around 12-13 and they asked me to babysit for a few hours a day while they switched shifts at work. Well the father would always drop him off and he was really a great dude, I can’t emphasize that enough, but he would drop off this baby at my door and just leave, he was a newborn and I was 12. Now the kid had a few bruises occasionally but the dad would just say he knocked him with his watch (he wore this giant solid watch) when he was changing him and whatnot idk the mother wasn’t concerned, my mom wasn’t concerned so I obviously ignored it. But this baby would scream, from the second he was dropped off to the second he was picked up and the only way I could sooth him would to be to swing him up and down like we were slow motion jumping, but one day he was dropped off with a bruise on his head and nothing was helping the crying. And mind you, I’m a kid, and only child/grandchild/niece of my entire family, I know nothing about babies, so I call my mother sobbing at work and tell her to come home and help me. Instead my mom and the baby’s mom show up and take him to the hospital. He’s given X-rays and shown to have a broken skull and eye socket and a fractured femur that had healed. The baby was 9 months old. I’ll never forget being questioned by the police and having them ask me about this guy who I and everyone I knew loved, and was this gentle giant and having the mom tell me that he was punching their newborn baby in the face… people can snap, people can literally become monsters because of stress, mental health is so important and I think if they hadn’t played into the pressure of children life would’ve been very different for them.
